_comment: Embedding models of the search page. `embeddings`: base URLs of chunks.f16.bin + chunks.json, tried in order (local copy first until the public HF dataset is live; then put the HF URL first). `onnx_repo`/`onnx_revision`: transformers.js weights, pinned to a revision (never 'main' once published). `dtype`: per runtime ('wasm' = CPU, 'webgpu'); a model without a 'wasm' entry needs WebGPU. onnx_ready=false: the query model is not published yet, Similar mode still works. `query_prefix` is prepended to queries only (documents were embedded without it). chunks.json.data_revision must equal manifest.json.revision. `description` is the one line shown to users; `notes` and `eval` are internal.

Parity of the shipped int8: mean top-20 overlap 0.915, pass.
